title: Advanced Function Toolkit Builder
instructions: Build a comprehensive toolkit of advanced utility functions demonstrating mastery of lambdas, decorators, *args/**kwargs, and functional programming patterns.
steps: Create decorator utilities including timing, caching, retry, and validation decorators
Implement functional programming utilities for composition, currying, and memoization
Build data processing utilities for transformation, filtering, and aggregation
Develop configuration and validation utilities with flexible argument handling
Ensure all functions are well-documented, tested, and demonstrate advanced concepts

expectedOutputFiles.function_toolkit.py: Contains all utility functions with comprehensive implementation

hints: Use @wraps to preserve function metadata in decorators
For currying, track accumulated arguments until all are provided
Use generator expressions for memory-efficient data processing
Make builder methods return self to enable method chaining

requirements: All decorator utilities implemented and working
Data processing handles large datasets efficiently
